item.title: Jamie O’Brien Tells Story of Time Angry Partiers Kicked in Volcom House Gate
item.description: On the latest episode of his podcast with Mason Ho, Jamie O'Brien shared a story about the time a bunch of guests weren't quite ready to leave the Volcom house.

item.title: Billy Kemper Made the Locals Round Happen at the Pipe Challenger; This Underdog Gave It Credence
item.description: Billy Kemper knew Pipeline specialists would show out if a Locals Round was included at the Pipe Challenger. Beloved underdog Joey Johnston justified his effort.

item.title: New Generation of Australian Surfers Could Be the Country’s Best World Title Hope in Decades
item.description: A new crop of young Australian surfers could bring world title glory back to Australia. Which hasn't happened in surfing in more than a decade.

item.title: Dolphin Does the Sickest Wheelie Off the Coast of California
item.description: Recently a boat full of whale watchers off the California coastline saw an example of how a dolphin with the zoomies gets the energy out: by doing a wheelie.

item.title: Australian Snowboarder Dies After Being Dragged by Chairlift at Japanese Resort
item.description: An Australian snowboarder has died at a Japanese resort after the 22-year-old's backpack became entangled in a chair lift and dragged her along the snow.

item.title: Prince Harry at the Surf Ranch Is Proof That Anyone Can Get Barreled If They’re Rich
item.description: Prince Harry got barreled again at the Surf Ranch. Getting barreled is no longer an experience for the experienced surfer — it's an experience for the rich.

item.title: Zack Flores Turned Trash Into Treasure When He Restored a Destroyed Surfboard
item.description: One man's trash is another man's treasure. Zack Flores is in the treasure hunting business. He breathed new life into a destoryed surfboard bound for the dump.

item.title: 4 Outer Banks Homes Fall Into the Ocean Amid Powerful Winter Storm
item.description: The Outer Banks endured a heartbreaking hurricane season. The local community suffered another massive blow over the weekend as four houses collapsed.

item.title: 13-Year-Old Swims For Hours in Rough Water to Rescue Family Swept Out to Sea
item.description: An ocean outing in Western Australia gone wrong could have ended tragically, if not for the efforts of a brave 13-year-old.

item.title: Another Construction Project on the Edge of the Uluwatu Cliffs Concerns Locals
item.description: For the last two years, construction has proliferated Uluwatu. Now, a new project built on the edge of the cave entrance to the surf spot has locals agitated.
